definitions.full: H2302. chadah II. [ חָדָה ] verb rejoice (Assyrian —adû Dl Pr 153 ; Aramaic , חֲדָא ) — Qal Imperfect 3masculine singular וַיִּ֫חַדְּ Exod 18:9 (E), and Jethro rejoiced over ( עַל of thing); jussive אַליִֿ֫חַדְּ Job 3:6 let it not rejoice among ( בְּ ) the days of the year, i.e. not take its place joyfully among them (figurative of day of Job's birth). — Klo proposes חָדוּבְּ֗֗֗ וְלֹא 1Sam 6:19 for וַיַּךְבְּ֗֗֗ compare also Dr Pi`el Imperfect suffix (causative) בְשִׂמְחְה תְּחַדֵּהוּ Psa 21:7 thou makest him joyful (Che cheerest him ) with gladness (|| בְרָכוֺת תְּשִׁיתֵהוּ ).

occurrences.englishText: Jethro rejoiced for all the goodness which Yahweh had done to Israel, in that he had delivered them out of the hand of the Egyptians.
As for that night, let thick darkness seize on it.
For the king trusts in Yahweh.
